verdict.rationale: Rainforest publishes its own API reference with per-endpoint pages (e.g., reference/create_merchant) and an OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification, but nothing in the pack shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable 'try it' examples. Standard OpenAPI paths returned 404 on probe. The sandbox environment is a separate feature and earns no credit here. missing for 10: evidence of interactive in-browser request execution, runnable code examples in the reference, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Create a merchant with an initial merchant application.
Rainforest supports OpenAPI Specifications (OAS) of the Rainforest API, version 3.1.0.
